**Which part of the project does this touch?**
Check `PROJECT.md`'s 20-module scope and `ROADMAP.md`'s phases first — is
this already planned, and if so, in which phase? Link it here.

**What problem does this solve?**
A restaurant/café/kitchen operator's real problem, not just "it would be
nice to have."

**Proposed solution**
What you'd build, at whatever level of detail you have. If it changes an
already-recorded architecture decision (see `ARCHITECTURE.md`), say what
changes and why — big proposals like that are better as a GitHub
Discussion first (see `CONTRIBUTING.md`).

**Alternatives considered**
Anything else you thought about and why you didn't go with it.

**Additional context**
Mockups, links to similar features in other POS/restaurant systems, etc.
